title: A company vehicle at the counter
purpose: What changes when the car belongs to a company account: unit number, purchase order, who may approve.
facts: The customer is the company; the vehicle is found by plate or unit number.
Six accounts are in the terms table; others are small business customers.
A1 needs its purchase-order number before the order is opened.

Booked work is approved; a driver approves found work up to 300 USD per visit (ledger s4.driver_limit); over it the named approver is called; unreachable: booked work only and an estimate within four working hours.
Nothing is paid at the counter for an account.
Story call 7: a company driver says "go ahead" to 380 USD of found work: over the limit, so the fleet contact is called.

list_items.section: A company vehicle at the counter
list_items.item: Whose is it? Find the vehicle by plate or unit number. It must be under the company, with the unit number.

list_items.section: A company vehicle at the counter
list_items.item: Is it an account? The six are in the terms table. Anybody else is a small business customer and pays at pick-up.

list_items.section: A company vehicle at the counter
list_items.item: Nickajack: purchase-order number first. No number, call their fleet manager before the order is opened.

list_items.section: A company vehicle at the counter
list_items.item: What was booked? Do that. It is approved.

list_items.section: A company vehicle at the counter
list_items.item: What else did we find? A driver may approve up to $300 for the whole visit. One limit, every account.

list_items.section: A company vehicle at the counter
list_items.item: Inside it: the driver may say yes. Write the driver's name as the approver.

list_items.section: A company vehicle at the counter
list_items.item: Over it, a driver cannot approve the work: call the person in the "Approves work" column. Not the driver's supervisor, not whoever answers their main line.

list_items.section: A company vehicle at the counter
list_items.item: Nobody reachable: booked work only. Estimate to the fleet contact within four working hours.

list_items.section: A company vehicle at the counter
list_items.item: Nothing is paid at the counter. It goes on the statement.

list_items.section: A company vehicle at the counter
list_items.item: If the driver is unhappy about waiting for an approval, that is fine. It is his company's rule, written down by his own boss.
